LPT : Fridge your chips/snacks for a more satisfying, refreshing taste

I work in construction, and have been bringing snacks/chips to work in a cooler. Anytime I eat it after it's freshly cold it just hits different. It tastes so good, so satisfying, makes me want to fridge everything lol. Just thought I'd let others know in case someone hasn't tried it! Test it for yourself! Pick your favorite brand chips, (Mine is Doritos) and fridge a zip lock bag full of em. Try it in like an hour or two and boom, you'll never want to go back to room temp pantry chips 5

Trying this this evening - will report back…

8/10 - would recommend

Please do :) I'm curious what others think
